author: 9to5Google
description:
Here’s my hands-on with the new Google Fitbit Edge, the Charge 6 replacement that sits between the Fitbit Air and Pixel Watch 5, covering its design, bands, Fitbit OS, built-in GPS, ECG, replaceable battery, and 7-day battery life. Subscribe for the full Fitbit Edge review on October 26th, where I’ll test it head-to-head against the Fitbit Air, Pixel Watch 5, and Fitbit Charge 6.
